parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols pim interface all mode spa.command: set protocols pim interface all mode sparse
set protocols pim interface all mode spa.explanation: 配置PIM协议在所有接口上使用稀疏模式。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 接口名称，all表示所有接口。

set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.command: set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/0
set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议在指定区域内的接口。

set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.command: set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/1
set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议在指定区域内的接口。

set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.command: set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0
set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议在指定区域内的环回接口。

set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 range 2.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议在指定区域内的地址范围。

set protocols pim rp local address 2001:.template: set protocols pim rp local address [parameter1]
set protocols pim rp local address 2001:.command: set protocols pim rp local address 2001:db8:1::2

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet6 address 2001:db8:1::2/64
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址及前缀长度。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet6 address 2001:db8:3::1/64
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址及前缀长度。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.1.1/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。
